user.title: User Profile
user.description: The profile of a system user, either a client or a mototaxista.

name.description: The user's customizable display name. Optional, falls back to email if empty.

role.description: The user's role in the system.

isOnline.description: Whether the user is currently online.

lastActive.description: The last active time of the user as a epoch millisecond timestamp.

ratingSum.description: Sum of all received rating stars.

chat.title: Chat Session
chat.description: An active chat session between a client and a mototaxista representing a taxi request.

id.description: The unique chat identifier, typically clientId_driverId.

clientId.description: The ID of the client user.

clientName.description: The client display name (or email if name is empty).

driverId.description: The ID of the active mototaxista driver user.

status.description: The current state of the request.

lastMessage.description: The content of the most recent message in the chat.

lastMessageTime.description: The timestamp of the most recent message.

isRated.description: Whether the chat has been rated by the client.

clientDeleted.description: Whether the client deleted this chat.

driverDeleted.description: Whether the driver deleted this chat.

message.title: Chat Message
message.description: An individual message sent within a chat session.

text.description: The text content of the message.

timestamp.description: The timestamp when the message was sent.

type.description: The message type (standard or system alerts).

users/{userId}.description: User profiles database partitioned by Firebase Auth uid.

chats/{chatId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Messages subcollection nested under the specific chat session.
